gt_source: Read every service's source and config in the vmworld2019app monorepo (front_end app.js/services/*.js, cart.py, order.py, payment server.js, user and catalogsvc Go db.go/main.go, all Dockerfiles and entrypoint scripts) and reconciled them with the plain manifests in kubernetes/kubernetes-manifests (Helm chart not used).

edges.mechanism: Node/Express front_end mounts routers (app.js:22-25) that proxy with the 'request' library to endpoints built in services/services.js as util.format('http://%s:%d', process.env.{X}_HOST, process.env.{X}_PORT) (no host default; port default 80); usersUrl + '/login' and '/users/:id'; USERS_HOST='users', USERS_PORT='8081' in the frontend Deployment.

Node/Express front_end mounts routers (app.js:22-25) that proxy with the 'request' library to endpoints built in services/services.js as util.format('http://%s:%d', process.env.{X}_HOST, process.env.{X}_PORT) (no host default; port default 80); catalogUrl + '/products', '/products/:id' and piped '/static/images/:id'; CATALOG_HOST='catalog', CATALOG_PORT='8082'.

Node/Express front_end mounts routers (app.js:22-25) that proxy with the 'request' library to endpoints built in services/services.js as util.format('http://%s:%d', process.env.{X}_HOST, process.env.{X}_PORT) (no host default; port default 80); cartUrl + '/cart/item/add|modify', '/cart/items', '/cart/clear', '/cart/total'; CART_HOST='cart', CART_PORT='5000'.

Node/Express front_end mounts routers (app.js:22-25) that proxy with the 'request' library to endpoints built in services/services.js as util.format('http://%s:%d', process.env.{X}_HOST, process.env.{X}_PORT) (no host default; port default 80); orderUrl + '/order/add/:userid'; ORDER_HOST='order', ORDER_PORT='6000'.

Python/Flask order.py builds paymenturi='http://'+PAYMENT_HOST+':'+PAYMENT_PORT (env, code default 'localhost':'9000', Dockerfile ENV localhost) and calls requests.get(paymenturi+'/live') and requests.post(paymenturi+'/pay'); PAYMENT_HOST='payment', PAYMENT_PORT='9000' in the order Deployment.

Python pymongo MongoClient(host=ORDER_DB_HOST, port=ORDER_DB_PORT) at import time (exits on failure); entrypoint also waits on 'mongo --host $ORDER_DB_HOST'; ORDER_DB_HOST='order-mongo' in the order Deployment (code/Dockerfile default localhost).

Python redis.StrictRedis(host=REDIS_HOST, port=REDIS_PORT) + ping at startup (exits on failure); entrypoint loops on 'redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST ping'; REDIS_HOST='cart-redis' in the cart Deployment (code/Dockerfile default localhost). Note: manifest sets REDIS_PASS while the code reads REDIS_PASSWORD, but the connection target is unaffected.

Go mgo.Dial('mongodb://user:pass@'+GetEnv('CATALOG_DB_HOST','0.0.0.0')+':'+CATALOG_DB_PORT) at startup; entrypoint waits on 'mongo --host $CATALOG_DB_HOST'; CATALOG_DB_HOST='catalog-mongo' in the catalog Deployment.

Go mgo.Dial('mongodb://user:pass@'+GetEnv('USERS_DB_HOST','0.0.0.0')+':'+USERS_DB_PORT) at startup; entrypoint waits on 'mongo --host $USERS_DB_HOST'; USERS_DB_HOST='users-mongo' in the users Deployment.
